description: Default capability for the Promptibrary main window.
_NOTE_start_dragging: SCA-930 — core:default doesn't include start-dragging. The data-tauri-drag-region JS shim fires the IPC, but without this permission Tauri rejects it silently. titleBarStyle: Overlay + hiddenTitle remove the OS's native drag handle, so this permission is required for the window to be movable.
